---
title: "07.Genomic_context"
author: "Diego Coleto"
date: "2026-11-03"
output: html_document

Where each ARG sits relative to the mobile genetic elements annotated on the same contig, and which ARGs sit next
to each other in more than one participant. Descriptive only.

What the annotations allow (checked on `Data/Processed/contig_mge.tsv` and `arg_hits.tsv`):

* ARG and element coordinates share the same contig identifiers and are both 1-based. No strand is available,
  so gene orientation cannot be studied.
* **Positioned elements**: insertion sequences (ISEScan), ICE and IME (ICEfinder; MAP labels them
  `conjugative_integron` and `integron`, but no integron caller was run) and prophages. Their coordinates
  locate them within the contig.
* **Contig classifications**: geNomad plasmid and viral calls span the whole contig. They say what the contig is,
  not where an element lies, so they cannot place an ARG inside or near an element.
* **Structural evidence** (repeats, compositional outliers) is kept apart, as in script 05.
* MAP was run on ARG-carrying contigs only, so there is no background rate from contigs without ARGs.

Each ARG hit gets the strongest level of evidence available, in this order:

1. inside or overlapping a positioned element;
2. within 5 kb of one. 5 kb spans a typical insertion sequence (0.7 to 2.5 kb) plus the flank of a composite
   transposon. It is used only to describe; nothing is inferred from it;
3. on the same contig as a positioned element, more than 5 kb away;
4. on a contig classified as plasmid or viral, with no positioned element;
5. structural evidence only;
6. no MGE annotation.

Levels 1 to 3 are physical co-location in an assembly. None of them shows mobilisation, transfer or conjugative
ability. Contigs end at repeats, so ARGs near a contig end may have lost an adjacent element in assembly. For that
reason every summary also reports how many hits have 5 kb of assembled sequence on both sides.

Diet groups are summarised per participant, without a test: only 113 contigs carry a positioned element within
5 kb of an ARG, and that subset is dominated by contig length.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

rm(list = ls())

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

table_dir <- here("3.-Assembly_based", "Results", "Tables")
```

# Data

```{r data}
arg_hits <- read_tsv(file.path(table_dir, "arg_hits.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
contig_mge <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "contig_mge.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
metadata <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "metadata.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
who <- read_tsv(here("Data", "Processed", "arg_who_classification.tsv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  distinct(AMR_variant = gene, gene_family)

positioned_types <- c("insertion_sequence" = "Insertion sequence", "conjugative_integron" = "ICE",
                      "integron" = "IME", "prophage" = "Prophage")
contig_class_types <- c("plasmid", "viral_sequence")
structural_types <- c("direct_repeat_element", "inverted_repeat_element", "compositional_outlier")
stopifnot(all(contig_mge$element_type %in% c(names(positioned_types), contig_class_types, structural_types)))

hits <- arg_hits %>%
  left_join(who, by = "AMR_variant") %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% select(sample_id, diet_group), by = "sample_id") %>%
  mutate(hit_id = row_number(),
         arg_start = pmin(AMR_start, AMR_end), arg_end = pmax(AMR_start, AMR_end),
         flank = pmin(arg_start - 1, contig_length - arg_end),
         flank_5kb = flank >= 5000,
         diet_group = factor(diet_group, levels = c("Omnivore", "Vegetarian", "Vegan")))
stopifnot(!anyNA(hits$gene_family), !anyNA(hits$diet_group))

cat("ARG hits:", nrow(hits), "| contigs:", n_distinct(paste(hits$sample_id, hits$contig_id)),
    "| participants:", n_distinct(hits$sample_id), "\n")

# Every positioned element must lie within its contig
positioned <- contig_mge %>%
  filter(element_type %in% names(positioned_types)) %>%
  inner_join(hits %>% distinct(sample_id, contig_id, contig_length), by = c("sample_id", "contig_id"))
stopifnot(all(positioned$element_start >= 1), all(positioned$element_end <= positioned$contig_length))
count(positioned, element_type)
```

# Evidence level of each ARG hit

```{r distances}
# Gap in bp between each ARG and each positioned element on its contig (0 when they overlap)
pairs <- hits %>%
  select(hit_id, sample_id, contig_id, arg_start, arg_end) %>%
  inner_join(positioned %>% select(sample_id, contig_id, element_type, element_start, element_end),
             by = c("sample_id", "contig_id"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(overlap = arg_start <= element_end & element_start <= arg_end,
         gap = if_else(overlap, 0, pmax(element_start - arg_end, arg_start - element_end) - 1))

nearest <- pairs %>%
  group_by(hit_id) %>%
  summarise(nearest_gap = min(gap),
            any_overlap = any(overlap),
            nearest_type = element_type[which.min(gap)],
            nearest_is_gap = suppressWarnings(min(gap[element_type == "insertion_sequence"])),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(nearest_is_gap = if_else(is.finite(nearest_is_gap), nearest_is_gap, NA_real_))

contig_flags <- contig_mge %>%
  group_by(sample_id, contig_id) %>%
  summarise(contig_class = any(element_type %in% contig_class_types),
            plasmid = any(element_type == "plasmid"),
            structural = any(element_type %in% structural_types),
            .groups = "drop")

evidence_levels <- c("Inside or overlapping a positioned MGE", "Within 5 kb of a positioned MGE",
                     "Same contig, more than 5 kb away", "Plasmid or viral contig, no positioned MGE",
                     "Structural evidence only", "No MGE annotation")

hit_context <- hits %>%
  left_join(nearest, by = "hit_id") %>%
  left_join(contig_flags, by = c("sample_id", "contig_id")) %>%
  mutate(across(c(contig_class, plasmid, structural), ~ replace_na(.x, FALSE)),
         evidence = case_when(
           any_overlap %in% TRUE ~ evidence_levels[1],
           nearest_gap <= 5000 ~ evidence_levels[2],
           !is.na(nearest_gap) ~ evidence_levels[3],
           contig_class ~ evidence_levels[4],
           structural ~ evidence_levels[5],
           TRUE ~ evidence_levels[6]),
         evidence = factor(evidence, levels = evidence_levels),
         nearest_type = unname(positioned_types[nearest_type]),
         length_bin = cut(contig_length, c(0, 5000, 10000, 20000, Inf),
                          labels = c("< 5 kb", "5-10 kb", "10-20 kb", "> 20 kb"), right = FALSE))

evidence_summary <- hit_context %>%
  count(evidence, name = "hits") %>%
  mutate(share = hits / sum(hits)) %>%
  left_join(hit_context %>% group_by(evidence) %>%
              summarise(contigs = n_distinct(paste(sample_id, contig_id)), participants = n_distinct(sample_id),
                        on_plasmid_contig = sum(plasmid), with_5kb_flanks = sum(flank_5kb), .groups = "drop"),
            by = "evidence")
evidence_summary

# The same among the hits whose 5 kb on both sides were assembled, so that "no element nearby" can be judged
evidence_evaluable <- hit_context %>%
  filter(flank_5kb) %>%
  count(evidence, name = "hits") %>%
  mutate(share = hits / sum(hits))
evidence_evaluable

# Nearest positioned element of the hits within 5 kb, by type
hit_context %>% filter(evidence %in% evidence_levels[1:2]) %>% count(evidence, nearest_type)

# Dependence on contig length
evidence_by_length <- hit_context %>%
  group_by(length_bin) %>%
  summarise(hits = n(), contigs = n_distinct(paste(sample_id, contig_id)),
            positioned_within_5kb = mean(evidence %in% evidence_levels[1:2]),
            any_positioned = mean(evidence %in% evidence_levels[1:3]),
            plasmid_contig = mean(plasmid), with_5kb_flanks = mean(flank_5kb), .groups = "drop")
evidence_by_length
```

# Distance to insertion sequences

```{r is distance}
is_distance <- hit_context %>%
  filter(!is.na(nearest_is_gap)) %>%
  transmute(sample_id, contig_id, gene_family, contig_length, flank, nearest_is_gap, plasmid, genus, diet_group)

is_distance %>%
  summarise(hits = n(), contigs = n_distinct(paste(sample_id, contig_id)),
            median_gap = median(nearest_is_gap), within_1kb = mean(nearest_is_gap <= 1000),
            within_5kb = mean(nearest_is_gap <= 5000), median_contig_length = median(contig_length))

# Contigs with and without an insertion sequence: length
hit_context %>%
  distinct(sample_id, contig_id, contig_length, has_is = !is.na(nearest_is_gap)) %>%
  group_by(has_is) %>%
  summarise(contigs = n(), median_length = median(contig_length))

# Gene families most often within 5 kb of an insertion sequence
is_families <- is_distance %>%
  filter(nearest_is_gap <= 5000) %>%
  group_by(gene_family) %>%
  summarise(hits = n(), participants = n_distinct(sample_id), median_gap = median(nearest_is_gap),
            genera = paste(names(sort(table(genus), decreasing = TRUE)), collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(hits %>% count(gene_family, name = "all_hits"), by = "gene_family") %>%
  mutate(share_of_family_hits = hits / all_hits) %>%
  arrange(desc(participants), desc(hits))
is_families
```

# ARGs next to each other

Adjacent ARG pairs: two consecutive ARG hits on the same contig separated by at most 1 kb (overlaps count as 0).
A pair is recurrent when it is found in at least five participants; it is counted in participants, not contigs.

```{r adjacent pairs}
adjacent <- hit_context %>%
  arrange(sample_id, contig_id, arg_start) %>%
  group_by(sample_id, contig_id) %>%
  filter(n() >= 2) %>%
  mutate(next_family = lead(gene_family), next_start = lead(arg_start),
         next_evidence = lead(evidence)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(next_family)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(gap = pmax(next_start - arg_end - 1, 0),
         pair = if_else(gene_family <= next_family, paste(gene_family, next_family, sep = " + "),
                        paste(next_family, gene_family, sep = " + ")),
         pair_positioned_5kb = evidence %in% evidence_levels[1:2] | next_evidence %in% evidence_levels[1:2])

cat("Consecutive ARG pairs:", nrow(adjacent), "| within 1 kb:", sum(adjacent$gap <= 1000), "\n")

recurrent_pairs <- adjacent %>%
  filter(gap <= 1000) %>%
  group_by(pair) %>%
  summarise(participants = n_distinct(sample_id), contigs = n_distinct(paste(sample_id, contig_id)),
            median_gap = median(gap),
            omnivore = n_distinct(sample_id[diet_group == "Omnivore"]),
            vegetarian = n_distinct(sample_id[diet_group == "Vegetarian"]),
            vegan = n_distinct(sample_id[diet_group == "Vegan"]),
            plasmid_contigs = n_distinct(paste(sample_id, contig_id)[plasmid]),
            positioned_mge_5kb = n_distinct(paste(sample_id, contig_id)[pair_positioned_5kb]),
            genera = paste(head(names(sort(table(replace_na(genus, "Unassigned")), decreasing = TRUE)), 3),
                           collapse = "; "),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(participants >= 5) %>%
  arrange(desc(participants))
recurrent_pairs
```

# Per participant, by diet group (descriptive)

```{r per participant}
per_participant <- hit_context %>%
  group_by(sample_id, diet_group) %>%
  summarise(hits = n(),
            positioned_within_5kb = mean(evidence %in% evidence_levels[1:2]),
            plasmid_contig = mean(plasmid),
            .groups = "drop")

context_by_diet <- per_participant %>%
  group_by(diet_group) %>%
  summarise(participants = n(), hits = sum(hits),
            participants_with_positioned_5kb = sum(positioned_within_5kb > 0),
            median_share_positioned_5kb = median(positioned_within_5kb),
            mean_share_positioned_5kb = mean(positioned_within_5kb),
            .groups = "drop")
context_by_diet
```

# Save

```{r save}
write_tsv(hit_context %>% select(sample_id, contig_id, contig_length, AMR_variant, gene_family, arg_start, arg_end,
                                 flank, flank_5kb, evidence, nearest_type, nearest_gap, nearest_is_gap, plasmid,
                                 genus, diet_group, length_bin),
          file.path(table_dir, "genomic_context_hits.tsv"))
write_tsv(evidence_summary, file.path(table_dir, "genomic_context_evidence.tsv"))
write_tsv(evidence_evaluable, file.path(table_dir, "genomic_context_evidence_evaluable.tsv"))
write_tsv(evidence_by_length, file.path(table_dir, "genomic_context_by_length.tsv"))
write_tsv(is_families, file.path(table_dir, "genomic_context_is_families.tsv"))
write_tsv(recurrent_pairs, file.path(table_dir, "genomic_context_adjacent_pairs.tsv"))
write_tsv(context_by_diet, file.path(table_dir, "genomic_context_by_diet.tsv"))
```
